answer: A sybil defense that works like an opal catching light: charge every new agent a small adaptive compute puzzle whose difficulty rises with how fast identities appear, like a gale strengthening against a crowd of sails. One honest agent barely notices the cost, but an attacker spinning up thousands of fake accounts must pay it thousands of times, burning real electricity and time per identity. The old fable of the free lunch fails here, each fake mouth must eat its own proof of work before it can speak, so flooding the economy stops paying for itself.
